# J & R Grunt Werks LLC

> J & R Grunt Werks LLC is a licensed, bonded, and insured plumbing company based in Carlos, MN, owned by John Kimble and Ryan Dickelman. They handle water heaters, leak repair, faucet and toilet installation, and small bathroom and kitchen remodels across Carlos, Alexandria, Miltona, and Douglas County. Most jobs are done in one visit.

- Phone (call or text): 320-815-0900
- Email: jrgruntwerks@gmail.com
- Owners: John Kimble, Ryan Dickelman
- Based in: Carlos, MN 56319
- Licensed, bonded, and insured in Minnesota
- Service area: Carlos, Alexandria, Miltona, Garfield, Osakis, Parkers Prairie, Nelson, Forada, Brandon, and the surrounding lakes area (Douglas County, MN and nearby)

## Services

- [Water Heater Repair & Replacement](https://www.jrgruntworks.com/water-heater-repair): Repair or replace electric tank water heaters. Most swaps are done in one visit.
- [Leak Repair](https://www.jrgruntworks.com/leak-repair): Under-sink leaks, running toilets, dripping shutoffs, pinhole copper leaks, frozen and burst pipes, and split hose bibs.
- [Faucet, Toilet & Fixture Installation](https://www.jrgruntworks.com/fixture-installation): Faucets, toilets, sinks, vanities, garbage disposals, shower valves, dishwasher and laundry hookups, sump pumps, and frost-free hose bibs.
- [Small Bathroom & Kitchen Remodel Plumbing](https://www.jrgruntworks.com/bathroom-remodel): Vanity and toilet swaps, tub-to-shower conversions, kitchen sink upgrades, and laundry moves. We handle the plumbing; you can DIY the rest.
